svg.title: TCP three-way handshake
svg.desc: SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK sync both sides' sequence numbers before any data flows. Sequence numbers are summarised in the captions (client ISN x, server ISN y) rather than drawn on tokens. Retransmission of a lost SYN and the FIN/ACK teardown are omitted; the last phase simply shows the connection closed again so the loop restarts cleanly. 1. Listening: server has done a passive open and waits. 2. SYN: client picks ISN x and sends SYN seq=x. 3. SYN-ACK: server replies seq=y, ack=x+1. 4. ACK: client acks y+1; now established. 5. Data: server established; data is sent and acked. 6. Torn down: after FIN teardown, server listens again.
